sheet

components · 0.1.1 · C1 · aj-c-sheet

The form of a screen: one rectangle, hairline-ruled into rows, one per screen. Its children are the record's rows (written, recorded, the note, the day, the mood), section heads, settings rows, or the auth content; every child after the first is ruled off above.
